The '''luggerwahl''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of four-legged creatures that were used as beasts of burden by [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]] and the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The luggerwahl was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Manipulator Alliance Pack on [[October 4]], [[2016]].<ref name="TOR" /><ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|SWTOR|status/787011778890698752|[[Star Wars: The Old Republic|The Old Republic]]|quote=Tower over the soldiers of Empress Vaylin on your Luggerwahl creature mount! Now live in the Manipulator Cartel Pack!}}</ref> It is meant as a [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] version of the [[luggabeast]], a similar creature that was used by the scavenger [[Teedo (Niima Outpost)|Teedo]] in the movie [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref>
